messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment started by sam_g for service api-gateway, rolling out api:v2 -> canary 10% (region: us-west-2)

sam_g: kicking off v2 canary. please watch /metrics and logs. /cc @maria_k @jenna
maria_k: watching. are we pinned for mobile clients? mobile SDKs still default to v1 unless header present.
jenna: client telemetry shows 0.7% of traffic sets X-Client-API: 2. Those are mostly mobile; they may hit schema mismatch.
infra-oncall: seeing a small uptick in 5xx on gateway instances in canary. currently 0.3% -> 0.8%
sam_g: bringing rollout to 30% paused. can someone verify traces for example request id 0b3f... ?
maria_k: checked trace; schema error in response for chat.complete when messages include 'tools' field.
product-ops: any customer-facing impact? do we need to notify clients on early access?
jenna: one enterprise tenant (acct-502) hit 400s for batch embeddings call. Recommend pin for that tenant.
sam_g: agreed. pinning acct-502 to v1 route. executing:
```
rbctl routes pin --account acct-502 --target api:v1 --reason "v2 schema mismatch for tools field"
```
deploy-bot: Route pin executed by sam_g at 1876500060. Rollout adjusted: canary back to 10%.
infra-oncall: after pin, 5xx rate back to baseline for that tenant but still slightly high overall.
sam_g: Ok plan: abort further rollout, open rollback if we can't root cause in 30m. @maria_k please file quick regression test and add to preflight.
maria_k: filing regression test now and adding to smoke suite. will update in ~15m.
product-ops: drafting quick note for affected customers, hold until we know calc of impacted calls.
jenna: can we add header-gating so only clients opting in get v2? That would reduce blast radius.
sam_g: yes let's enable header gate for v2 only. config command:
```
rbctl feature toggle --feature v2-header-gate --state enabled
```
deploy-bot: Feature toggle applied. v2 now requires header X-API-Version:2 to route to v2.
infra-oncall: after header gate, overall error rate back to normal. good.
sam_g: Decision: abort general rollout; keep v2 gated behind header + pinned problematic accounts to v1. We'll reschedule a controlled rollout after regression test and release notes updated.
product-ops: tracking in release notes: add section on header-gate, tenant pinning, and migration steps.
jenna: FYI: will add note to SDK changelog and a snippet showing header usage.
sam_g: thanks all. moving deployment to canceled state and creating follow-up PR and postmortem docs.
deploy-bot: Deployment status: canceled by sam_g at 1876500125. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/deploy/1876500000
sam_g: I'll create a postmortem thread once we have RCA. Good catch everyone :thumbsup:
